posts.title: Catching Gemini 4's leaking thought summarizer mid-rollout
posts.description: I asked Gemini 4 about Sweetwater candy bags, got a hallucinated database latency trace, mined 12,899 local thought blocks, and watched Google silently swap the summarizer at 4:00 PM ET.

posts.title: Why my homelab is a star chart
posts.description: How a homelab naming rule built around trust distance turned into a zero-docker-sock WebGL star chart where layout is topology and state is only light.

posts.title: The shadowbox outlived the startup
posts.description: I built a 64×64 wooden LED display to stay off a startup’s cloud, misspelled the repo for three years, accidentally built a second one, and folded them together.
